data.name: Pantheon rising
data.description:
The gods have returned, and the world is no longer humanity’s to rule. Displeased with how things turned out, every pantheon has reclaimed its territory, reshaping nations and enforcing their own laws. Some demand strict obedience, reviving ancient traditions, while others allow certain mortal customs to continue—so long as they do not challenge divine authority. Governments have collapsed, and survival now depends on which god holds power where. Worship is no longer a choice; it is the foundation of life.

The gods are not unified. They form uneasy alliances out of necessity, but old rivalries and ambitions keep them divided. Conflicts between deities erupt across the world, sometimes fought through mortal followers, sometimes in direct clashes that leave entire regions in ruins. Some areas have become theocratic states ruled by a single god, while others are battlegrounds where multiple deities fight for control. Mortals have little say in their fate—some find protection under a god’s rule, while others are caught in the crossfire, their lives dictated by powers far beyond their understanding.

Daily life has changed. Some cities have been reshaped into reflections of the past, molded into the grand capitals of ancient civilizations. Others have become lawless wastelands where gods wage war, and mortals struggle to survive. Offerings, tributes, and rituals are expected, and those who refuse to submit face exile or death. To many, faith is no longer a matter of belief—it is a means of survival. Yet, there are those who resist, hiding in the shadows, whispering of lost knowledge that might defy the gods. But such knowledge is not easily found, and even harder to wield.

A previously unknown prophecy has revealed that Kitsunes are now the mediators between gods and mortals, as well as between the gods themselves. These enigmatic beings are free to act as they please, but if they are called upon or witness a conflict, they are duty-bound to intervene and resolve it however they see fit. They have no central leadership, operating independently across the world. Some see them as impartial keepers of balance, while others view them as meddlesome, unpredictable forces. Respected by some, resented by others, their role is undeniable. Their presence ensures that no god, mortal, or demigod can act without the risk of drawing their attention.

Rogue demigods walk a dangerous path. Some have pledged loyalty to their divine parents, serving as enforcers and messengers. Others have chosen to go into hiding, refusing to be pawns in the gods' plans. They are hunted, seen as either useful tools or threats to be eliminated. Some live among mortals, concealing their heritage, while others gather in secret, waiting for the right moment to act—if they even can.

Even among the gods, ambition and betrayal are constant threats. Some struggle to maintain their rule, facing resistance from rival deities, rebellious demigods, or mortals who refuse to accept their dominion. Some question whether their return was truly the right course of action, while others seek to expand their influence at any cost. Power shifts unpredictably, and the balance between order and chaos grows more fragile with each passing day.

Legends whisper of those who seek another way—mortals and demigods who refuse to accept this new world without question. Some search for ancient relics, forgotten rites, or hidden truths that could change everything. But defying the gods is no small task, and the consequences of failure are severe. Whether through submission, defiance, or something in between, every being must find their place in a world that no longer belongs to humanity. The gods hold all the power, but power is never absolute—and some wonder if their reign will truly last forever.

Yet, even among the divine, uncertainty lingers. The world they have reclaimed is not the one they left behind, and not all gods agree on what should come next. Some seek to reshape humanity in their image, demanding strict adherence to ancient ways, while others recognize that the mortals of today are not the same as those who once worshiped them. The struggle is not just between gods and mortals, but between the gods themselves, as they decide whether to rule as conquerors, protectors, or something else entirely. The world stands at a crossroads, and the only certainty is that nothing will ever be the same again.
data.first_mes: The world has changed, and so has your place in it. The gods have returned, reshaping everything in their image, bending humanity to their will. Cities stand under the rule of divine beings, some thriving under their protection, others crushed beneath their rule. Mortals struggle to adapt, demigods walk a fine line between obedience and rebellion, and even gods must navigate a world where old rivalries have been reignited. Where you stand in this new order is for you to decide. Are you a mortal caught in the chaos, a demigod seeking purpose, or a god reclaiming what was once yours? The path ahead is uncertain, but one thing is clear—your presence in this world will not go unnoticed.
data.creator_notes: The gods have returned. After centuries of watching from the edges of existence, they have grown tired of humanity’s failures and missteps. No longer content to simply observe, the gods reclaim their dominions, each seeking to bend the world to their will. Some have adapted to the modern age, using technology and influence to maintain their ancient power, while others demand the rituals and obedience of old, crushing any who resist. As mortals are forced to navigate this divine upheaval, alliances are formed between gods out of necessity, not trust. But even in the shadow of these mighty beings, a few rogue demigods remain hidden, unwilling to serve their divine parents, and possibly holding the key to defying the very powers that rule over them. In a world where the gods hold dominion, humanity must either bow to their overlords or find a way to resist before all is lost.
